about.tagline: A modern editor for Windows registry data.
about.careful-work.description: Browse, inspect, edit, import, and export registry data with explicit architecture views, confirmation before destructive changes, and recoverable app-created backups.
about.native-windows.description: Built with WinUI 3 and the Windows App SDK.
about.architectures.description: Native release builds for modern Windows PCs.
about.publisher.description: Registry is maintained by Chromatic. Visit our website or send product feedback directly to the team.
journal.description: Restore previous states captured before changes made in Registry.
label.name: Name
address.tooltip: Paste a Registry Editor or PowerShell path, then press Enter to open it.
journal.removed.message: The snapshot was removed from Journal.
journal.restore-confirmation: This will write the captured snapshot back to the registry. Current values in that snapshot scope may be replaced.
journal.remove-confirmation: This only removes the saved snapshot from Journal. It does not change the registry.
import.direct-warning: The changes are applied directly. Export the target key first if you need a backup copy.
import.preview-description: Review the operations before applying them to the registry.
